_meta.description: Public bodies Deni routes citizens to. Each is a real institution with a documented mandate. Verify current contact details at demo/use time.

forums.name: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC)
forums.handles: Misuse of personal data, contact-scraping, abusive data-driven collection.
forums.channel: Complaint to ODPC (odpc.go.ke). Data Protection (Complaints Handling) Regulations, LN 264/2021.
what_to_include: What data was used and how (screenshots of messages to your contacts)

forums.name: Central Bank of Kenya (CBK)
forums.handles: Digital Credit Provider licensing and conduct; unlicensed lenders.
forums.channel: Report to CBK (Digital Credit Providers supervision).
what_to_include: Whether they are on the licensed DCP list

forums.name: Competition Authority of Kenya (CAK)
forums.handles: False/misleading representations, unconscionable conduct, non-disclosure of terms.
what_to_include: What you were told vs the actual terms
How the cost was hidden or misrepresented

forums.name: Court (with a demand letter first)
forums.handles: Wrongful repossession, return of asset, damages.
forums.channel: A demand letter to the financier; if unresolved, a suit. Consider a lawyer or legal aid.
what_to_include: Any default notice received (or proof none was served)

forums.name: Credit Reference Bureau (TransUnion / Metropol / Creditinfo)
forums.channel: Dispute with the licensed bureau under CRB Regulations 2020 (LN 55/2020).
what_to_include: Why it is wrong (paid / disputed / unlicensed lender)

forums.name: Small Claims Court
forums.handles: Money claims up to KES 1,000,000 — refunds, overpayments, the value of a wrongly seized asset. You can represent yourself; no advocate required.
forums.channel: File a statement of claim at a Small Claims Court registry. Pay the prescribed filing fee, attach your evidence, and serve the other party. The court is designed for self-represented claimants and aims to decide within 60 days.
what_to_include: The lender/other party's name and address
The exact amount you are claiming and how you calculated it
What you want the court to order
